A typed missing value

Source: R/vectors.R
na.Rd

na(type) is a length-one missing value of a type, for the types base R has no NA literal for. It declares a column to be filled later: zutable(id = 1:3, total = na(decimal(18, 4))).

Usage

na(type)

Arguments

type

A type, as in schema().

Value

A length-one vector of type, missing.

Examples

na(int32)
#> [1] NA
na(timestamp("us", "UTC"))
#> [1] NA
na(enum(c("lo", "hi")))
#> [1] <NA>
#> Levels: lo hi
